scope: Public aggregate measurements only; no raw observation states, credentials, host paths, full TLE catalogue or proprietary orbit inputs.

catalog_identification.fitting_reference: Vallado and Crawford 2008, AIAA 2008-6770, Section VI / Appendix C

appendix_c_identity.method: pdftotext -layout; AppendixC only; whitespace-collapse each TLE line only

catalog_identification.propagator_reference: Vallado, Crawford, Hujsak and Kelso 2006, AIAA 2006-6753

protocol.dataset: Vallado and Crawford 2008 Appendix C; TWOLINE.TXT verified against the paper after whitespace normalization
protocol.reference_model: SGP4 2.27, WGS72, improved operation mode i
protocol.sampling: 61 inclusive samples over one original TLE mean period P; 31 strictly future samples P + P/62 through 1.5P. Fit cadence P/60; hold-out cadence P/62. UTC datetimes are rounded to representable microseconds; reference states are generated at those actual epochs.
protocol.derivatives: Central finite differences or JAX automatic differentiation in the existing ephemeris fitters
protocol.acceptance: Existing solver criteria and maximum 35 iterations retained; every failure/nonconvergence reported. Physical errors are measurements, with no new error allowance. This candidate subset is not a full public/current relative gate.
protocol.scope: Four of 67 catalogue cases: SGP4 self-consistency fitting, separate from GMAT-generated and real-ephemeris fitting

appendix_c_subset.coverage: Four of 67 cases, eight candidate fits; remaining 63 not measured in this bounded campaign
appendix_c_subset.runtime_scope: Worker wall time includes imports/JIT, fit, full-precision and exported metric evaluation. It excludes reference generation and is not a performance benchmark.

gps_fixed_bstar.physical_result_acceptance: Accepted historical result: approximately 130 m fit RMS; the roughly 53-day forecast limitation remains documented. No new release condition is introduced.
gps_fixed_bstar.holdout_rtn: not recorded in selected fixed-Bstar receipt
gps_fixed_bstar.exported_tle_metrics: not recorded in selected fixed-Bstar receipt

prior_measured_comparisons.acceptance: The 20 EQN, eight COE and four historical-mission matched comparisons have identical public/current full-precision and exported metrics (896 scalar checks), under existing zero-slack rules. This does not establish absolute physical truth or qualify the full 67-case catalogue.

limits: Synthetic SGP4 self-consistency, numerical GMAT-generated observations and historical mission ephemerides are distinct input families.

A complete contemporary matched 67-case Appendix C campaign and the 2006 propagator verification campaign are not claimed. Historical exploratory notebook traces are not a complete modern fit/hold-out receipt.
Unconverged 08195/JAX last-iterate metrics remain unconverged. Matching public behavior provides context, not a waiver.
GPS/ICESat references are project-retained historical files. Exact identity to an official paper data bundle and physical uncertainties were not established.
Published errors measure reference agreement, not a general operational accuracy promise.
